Symptom: Pump does not deliver any liquid
Cause / Fault: Pump not primed (air left in pump or suction line)
Remedy / Action: Re-prime the pump and verify the suction line is full of liquid
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump does not deliver any liquid
Remedy / Action: Inspect the suction line and remove the obstruction
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump does not deliver any liquid
Remedy / Action: Inspect the impeller and remove the obstruction
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump does not deliver any liquid
Remedy / Action: Check the rotation and correct it (can be a sign of impending severe damage)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump does not deliver any liquid
Cause / Fault: Foot valve or suction pipe not submerged enough (vortexing)
Remedy / Action: Check the suction source level and correct the submergence
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump does not deliver any liquid
Remedy / Action: Review and revise the suction level
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide; Grundfos, Centrifugal Pump Installation and Operating Instructions, n.d., https://api.grundfos.com/literature/Grundfosliterature-6142526.pdf

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Remedy / Action: Replace the gasket and tighten all connections properly
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Cause / Fault: Air leak through the stuffing box
Remedy / Action: Inspect packing and mechanical seals; add a pressurized flush if necessary
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Cause / Fault: Impeller partially clogged (often with rattling noise or vibration)
Remedy / Action: Inspect the impeller for debris and remove the obstruction
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Remedy / Action: Adjust the impeller clearance to the correct distance
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Remedy / Action: Review the design against the specifications and revise if needed
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Remedy / Action: Inspect impeller performance and replace it as needed
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Remedy / Action: Clean the strainer and suction pipe
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: Shubham Industries, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, n.d., https://www.shubhampump.com/troubleshooting

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Remedy / Action: Check valve positions and open as required
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: Shubham Industries, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, n.d., https://www.shubhampump.com/troubleshooting

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Cause / Fault: Solids or deposits obstruct the impeller
Remedy / Action: Open the pump per its maintenance procedure and clean the impeller
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: Shubham Industries, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, n.d., https://www.shubhampump.com/troubleshooting

Symptom: Low flow or head below rating
Cause / Fault: Erosion or corrosion damages the impeller blades
Remedy / Action: Replace the impeller if badly worn or damaged
Measurable condition: Flow or head below the rated values on the pump curve
Source: Shubham Industries, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, n.d., https://www.shubhampump.com/troubleshooting

Symptom: Low discharge pressure
Cause / Fault: Pump rotating in the wrong direction
Remedy / Action: Check motor rotation and correct it
Source: General Pump & Machinery, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting, n.d., https://www.generalpumpandmachinery.com/pdf/Troubleshooting%20Centrifugal%20Pump%20Instructions%20and%20Repair.pdf

Symptom: Low discharge pressure
Remedy / Action: Check motor speed and the drive
Measurable condition: Speed below nameplate speed
Source: General Pump & Machinery, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting, n.d., https://www.generalpumpandmachinery.com/pdf/Troubleshooting%20Centrifugal%20Pump%20Instructions%20and%20Repair.pdf

Symptom: Low discharge pressure
Remedy / Action: Inspect the impeller and wear parts for damage and replace them
Source: General Pump & Machinery, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting, n.d., https://www.generalpumpandmachinery.com/pdf/Troubleshooting%20Centrifugal%20Pump%20Instructions%20and%20Repair.pdf

Symptom: Pump loses prime or starts then stops
Remedy / Action: Re-prime the pump thoroughly
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump loses prime or starts then stops
Cause / Fault: Air or vapor accumulating in the suction line
Remedy / Action: Review the suction piping and remove air pockets
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump loses prime or starts then stops
Cause / Fault: Air leak in the suction line
Remedy / Action: Check gaskets and seals and replace them if needed
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump loses prime or starts then stops
Cause / Fault: Excessive suction lift or vapor formation
Remedy / Action: Verify the liquid level and reduce suction lift; prime the pump correctly
Source: General Pump & Machinery, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting, n.d., https://www.generalpumpandmachinery.com/pdf/Troubleshooting%20Centrifugal%20Pump%20Instructions%20and%20Repair.pdf

Symptom: Air bubbles or gas in the discharge
Cause / Fault: Air entering through the suction line
Remedy / Action: Check suction joints and pipework for leaks
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Air bubbles or gas in the discharge
Cause / Fault: Suction inlet not properly submerged or supplied
Remedy / Action: Keep the suction inlet properly submerged or supplied
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Bearings run hot
Cause / Fault: Improper alignment of pump and driver
Remedy / Action: Re-align the pump and driver
Measurable condition: Bearing temperature above 80 C (reference value)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide; Ecologix Systems, Wastewater Plant Troubleshooting Guide: Pumps, https://ecologixsystems.com/articles/wastewater-pump-troubleshooting

Symptom: Bearings run hot
Cause / Fault: Improper lubrication (insufficient, wrong or contaminated lubricant)
Remedy / Action: Check the correct non-foaming lubricant, level and quantity
Measurable condition: Bearing temperature above 80 C (reference value)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide; Ecologix Systems, Wastewater Plant Troubleshooting Guide: Pumps, https://ecologixsystems.com/articles/wastewater-pump-troubleshooting

Symptom: Bearings run hot
Remedy / Action: Check cooler water lines and liquid levels
Measurable condition: Bearing temperature above 80 C (reference value)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide; Ecologix Systems, Wastewater Plant Troubleshooting Guide: Pumps, https://ecologixsystems.com/articles/wastewater-pump-troubleshooting

Symptom: Bearings run hot
Remedy / Action: Inspect and replace the bearings
Measurable condition: Bearing temperature above 80 C (reference value)
Source: Grundfos, Centrifugal Pump Installation and Operating Instructions, n.d., https://api.grundfos.com/literature/Grundfosliterature-6142526.pdf; Ecologix Systems, Wastewater Plant Troubleshooting Guide: Pumps, https://ecologixsystems.com/articles/wastewater-pump-troubleshooting

Symptom: Bearings run hot
Remedy / Action: Correct the vibration problem (alignment, balance, mounting)
Measurable condition: Bearing temperature above 80 C (reference value); Vibration velocity above 4.5 mm/s RMS (reference value)
Source: Grundfos, Centrifugal Pump Installation and Operating Instructions, n.d., https://api.grundfos.com/literature/Grundfosliterature-6142526.pdf; Ecologix Systems, Wastewater Plant Troubleshooting Guide: Pumps, https://ecologixsystems.com/articles/wastewater-pump-troubleshooting; Oxmaint, Centrifugal Pump Failures & Troubleshooting Guide for Manufacturing Plants, https://oxmaint.com/industries/manufacturing-plant/centrifugal-pump-common-failures

Symptom: Seal leakage
Remedy / Action: Check the gland nuts and tighten them to specification
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Seal leakage
Remedy / Action: Inspect the stuffing box and re-pack it
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Seal leakage
Remedy / Action: Replace the shaft sleeve
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Seal leakage
Remedy / Action: Replace the seal
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Seal leakage
Cause / Fault: Mechanical seal overheated or damaged by dry running
Remedy / Action: Inspect the seal and its flushing arrangement; correct the cause of overheating
Source: Oxmaint, Centrifugal Pump Failures & Troubleshooting Guide for Manufacturing Plants, https://oxmaint.com/industries/manufacturing-plant/centrifugal-pump-common-failures

Symptom: Seal leakage
Remedy / Action: Check the seal is correctly installed and the gland nuts are tightened to the recommended level
Source: HISCO Pump, How Do You Troubleshoot a Centrifugal Pump?, https://hiscopump.com/how-do-you-troubleshoot-a-centrifugal-pump

Symptom: Seal leakage
Remedy / Action: Correct the vibration cause; the seal is often the victim, not the cause
Measurable condition: Vibration velocity above 4.5 mm/s RMS (reference value)
Source: Oxmaint, Centrifugal Pump Failures & Troubleshooting Guide for Manufacturing Plants, https://oxmaint.com/industries/manufacturing-plant/centrifugal-pump-common-failures

Symptom: Excessive power draw or motor trips
Cause / Fault: Actual head lower than design head
Remedy / Action: Throttle the discharge valve or trim the impeller to suit the system head
Measurable condition: Motor current above nameplate full-load current
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Excessive power draw or motor trips
Cause / Fault: Liquid heavier or more viscous than designed for
Remedy / Action: Review the motor size for the liquid and increase motor power if needed
Measurable condition: Motor current above nameplate full-load current
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Excessive power draw or motor trips
Remedy / Action: Re-pack the pump to the correct level
Measurable condition: Motor current above nameplate full-load current
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Excessive power draw or motor trips
Remedy / Action: Check the pump internals for anything locking up or rubbing
Measurable condition: Motor current above nameplate full-load current
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Excessive power draw or motor trips
Remedy / Action: Inspect and replace damaged bearings
Measurable condition: Motor current above nameplate full-load current
Source: Grundfos, Centrifugal Pump Installation and Operating Instructions, n.d., https://api.grundfos.com/literature/Grundfosliterature-6142526.pdf

Symptom: Pump is noisy or vibrates excessively
Cause / Fault: Improper alignment of pump and driver
Remedy / Action: Re-align the pump and driver, then monitor
Measurable condition: Vibration velocity above 4.5 mm/s RMS (reference value)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump is noisy or vibrates excessively
Cause / Fault: Impeller partially clogged or out of balance
Remedy / Action: Inspect the impeller for clogs and balance
Measurable condition: Vibration velocity above 4.5 mm/s RMS (reference value)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump is noisy or vibrates excessively
Cause / Fault: Broken or bent impeller or impeller shaft
Remedy / Action: Inspect and replace the damaged parts
Measurable condition: Vibration velocity above 4.5 mm/s RMS (reference value)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump is noisy or vibrates excessively
Cause / Fault: Pump foundation not rigid (loose hold-down bolts or feet)
Remedy / Action: Tighten the base, pump and motor bolts, then re-check alignment
Measurable condition: Vibration velocity above 4.5 mm/s RMS (reference value)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump is noisy or vibrates excessively
Remedy / Action: Replace the bearings as needed
Measurable condition: Vibration velocity above 4.5 mm/s RMS (reference value)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump is noisy or vibrates excessively
Cause / Fault: Suction or discharge piping not anchored correctly
Remedy / Action: Review the design specifications and anchor the piping
Measurable condition: Vibration velocity above 4.5 mm/s RMS (reference value)
Source: PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Pump is noisy or vibrates excessively
Remedy / Action: Check suction conditions and remove trapped air
Source: Grundfos, Centrifugal Pump Installation and Operating Instructions, n.d., https://api.grundfos.com/literature/Grundfosliterature-6142526.pdf

Symptom: Pump is noisy or vibrates excessively
Cause / Fault: Loose mounting or contact between rotating and stationary parts
Remedy / Action: Tighten mounting hardware and inspect internal clearances
Source: Grundfos, Centrifugal Pump Installation and Operating Instructions, n.d., https://api.grundfos.com/literature/Grundfosliterature-6142526.pdf

Symptom: Crackling or gravel-like noise
Cause / Fault: Suction cavitation (suction pressure too low for the liquid)
Remedy / Action: Check the liquid level, clean the suction strainer, reduce suction losses and confirm the suction-pressure margin
Measurable condition: NPSH available below NPSH required
Source: Nuova Darimpianti, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting: Cavitation, Vibration and Seal Leaks, 2026, https://nuovadarimpianti.it/en/guides-and-insights/pumps/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide/; Chem-Casts, A Practical Guide to Troubleshooting Centrifugal Pump Cavitation, https://chem-casts.com/knowledge/a-practical-guide-to-troubleshooting-centrifugal-pump-cavitation; PSG Dover, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, 2022, https://www.psgdover.com/blackmer/news/article/2022/05/04/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide

Symptom: Crackling or gravel-like noise
Cause / Fault: Discharge cavitation (internal recirculation at low flow)
Remedy / Action: Open the discharge valve toward the design flow range
Measurable condition: Noise gets worse when the discharge is throttled
Source: Chem-Casts, A Practical Guide to Troubleshooting Centrifugal Pump Cavitation, https://chem-casts.com/knowledge/a-practical-guide-to-troubleshooting-centrifugal-pump-cavitation

Symptom: Coupling wears or fails repeatedly
Remedy / Action: Align the shafts to the coupling maker tolerance
Measurable condition: Alignment tolerance specified by the coupling manufacturer
Source: Nuova Darimpianti, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting: Cavitation, Vibration and Seal Leaks, 2026, https://nuovadarimpianti.it/en/guides-and-insights/pumps/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide/

Symptom: Coupling wears or fails repeatedly
Remedy / Action: Inspect the coupling element and replace it
Source: Nuova Darimpianti, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting: Cavitation, Vibration and Seal Leaks, 2026, https://nuovadarimpianti.it/en/guides-and-insights/pumps/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide/

Symptom: Coupling wears or fails repeatedly
Remedy / Action: Secure the base
Source: Nuova Darimpianti, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting: Cavitation, Vibration and Seal Leaks, 2026, https://nuovadarimpianti.it/en/guides-and-insights/pumps/centrifugal-pump-troubleshooting-guide/

Symptom: Pump overheats
Remedy / Action: Confirm the pump operates within its specified range
Measurable condition: Bearing temperature above 80 C (reference value)
Source: Shubham Industries, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, n.d., https://www.shubhampump.com/troubleshooting

Symptom: Pump overheats
Remedy / Action: Confirm the pump is filled with liquid before and during operation
Measurable condition: Bearing temperature above 80 C (reference value)
Source: Shubham Industries, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, n.d., https://www.shubhampump.com/troubleshooting; Oxmaint, Centrifugal Pump Failures & Troubleshooting Guide for Manufacturing Plants, https://oxmaint.com/industries/manufacturing-plant/centrifugal-pump-common-failures

Symptom: Pump overheats
Remedy / Action: Check rotating clearances
Measurable condition: Bearing temperature above 80 C (reference value)
Source: Shubham Industries, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, n.d., https://www.shubhampump.com/troubleshooting

Symptom: Pump overheats
Remedy / Action: Check and replace the bearings; confirm lubrication
Measurable condition: Bearing temperature above 80 C (reference value)
Source: Shubham Industries, Centrifugal Pump Troubleshooting Guide, n.d., https://www.shubhampump.com/troubleshooting; Ecologix Systems, Wastewater Plant Troubleshooting Guide: Pumps, https://ecologixsystems.com/articles/wastewater-pump-troubleshooting
